controls.title: Logical Access Security & Identity Management
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.

controls.title: User Registration & Access Lifecycle
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity.

controls.title: Revocation of Access Permissions
controls.description: The entity revokes system access when user employment or contract relationships terminate or when access is no longer required.

controls.title: Boundary Protection & Network Segmentation
controls.description: The entity implements logical boundaries and network segmentation controls to prevent unauthorized perimeter access.

controls.title: Transmission of Protected Data
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes.

controls.title: Security Incident Detection & Monitoring
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of controls to detect anomalies and unauthorized actions.

controls.title: Change Management & Version Control
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.
